crossRefs.note: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field…
Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites…

translations.web: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
translations.bsb: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
translations.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase
translations.asv: And Jehovah thy God will cast out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
